test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question:
Consider the below mentioned statements and select the correct option with respect to the Indian folk and tribal dance forms:

i) Matki is the folk dance of Assam.

ii) Thang Ta is the folk dance of Manipur.

iii) Fugdi is the folk dance of Goa.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both (ii) and (iii) are right.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Matki** is a folk dance, but it is not from **Assam**. It is a popular dance form of the **Malwa region in Madhya Pradesh**, performed by women carrying earthen pots (Matki) on their heads. Hence, statement (i) is incorrect.
 
• **Thang Ta** is a traditional martial art-based dance form of **Manipur**. It combines dance, martial skills, and rituals and represents a significant aspect of Manipuri culture. Hence, statement (ii) is correct.
 
• **Fugdi** is a folk dance of **Goa**, performed by women during religious and festive occasions. It is characterized by its fast rhythmic movements and circular formations. Hence, statement (iii) is correct.
 
• The correct option is that both **statements (ii) and (iii)** are accurate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Matki Dance**__

 __
 
• **Matki** is performed by women from the **Malwa region in Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• It involves balancing an earthen pot (Matki) on the head while performing graceful movements.
 
• This dance form is often performed during celebrations like **festivals and weddings**.
 
 
 
• **Thang Ta**__
 __
 
• Thang Ta is a martial art form that is indigenous to **Manipur**.
 
• The term "Thang" refers to the sword, and "Ta" refers to the spear.
 
• It showcases the **valor and tradition** of Manipuri warriors, blending combat techniques with artistic expressions.
 
 
 
• **Fugdi Dance**__
 
 
• **Fugdi** is performed by the women of **Goa**, especially during the **Ganesh Chaturthi festival**.
 
• The dance is performed in a circular or serpentine formation and is accompanied by folk songs.
 
• It is a vibrant representation of **Goan culture**.
